artStyle.description: One line describing the look of every picture made for this world (used by image tools), e.g. "painterly fantasy concept art, warm desert light".

writingStyle.description: How the book is written: point of view, tense, tone, audience, what to avoid, maybe a sample paragraph. AI tools that write in the book follow it.

start.description: Absolute year on the world axis that year 1 of this era maps to.

end.description: Optional last absolute year of the era; without it the era lasts until the next one starts.

color.description: Optional colour of the era band on the timeline.

chapterYears.description: Split each era into chapters of this many years; default one chapter per era.

trim.description: Print trim size of the Story Book. Default 6x9 (inches).

rightHandChapters.description: For printed books: start every chapter (and the title page, dedication, epigraph and contents) on a right-hand page, adding blank pages. Default false.

copyright.description: Copyright page text. The page is always printed; a plain notice with the author and year is used when this is empty.

dropCap.description: First letter of each chapter: none, raised (big, on the first line; default) or dropped (two lines deep).

dateStamps.description: Show chapter dates at the top right of each chapter opening (and dates on chronicle pages). Default true.

bodyFont.description: Body text font: DejaVu Serif (default), DejaVu Sans or a bundled font.

bodySize.description: Body text size in points. Default 10.5.

chapterFont.description: Chapter title font. Default the body font.

chapterSize.description: Chapter title size in points. Default 19.

lineSpacing.description: Line spacing as a multiple of the body size. Default 1.45.

coverTitleColor.description: Front cover title colour in the book; default the cover's own.

coverTitleSize.description: Front cover title size in percent of the default.

authorSize.description: Author line size on the cover and title page, in percent of the default.

cover.description: How the world's book looks on the library shelf.

color2.description: Bottom of the cover gradient; the same as color for a plain cover.

image.description: Cover picture, relative to the world folder, or none.

font.description: Title font family: a bundled cover font or a system font.

showTitle.description: false hides the title on the front cover; it stays on the spine.

showEmblem.description: false hides the emblem on the front cover; it stays on the spine.

titlePos.description: Where the title sits on the front cover, in percent of the room inside the frame (50 = centred). Without it, the default place.

emblemPos.description: Where the emblem sits on the front cover, in percent of the room inside the frame (50 = centred). Without it, the default place.

maps.description: Maps of the world: pictures with places pinned on them (each place's pins).

id.description: Made from the first name; it stays when the map is renamed, since the pins use it.

image.description: The picture, relative to the world folder. The app keeps it in maps/.

place.description: The place the map shows (a city on a map of the land), by id or name. Its pin on other maps opens this map.

fields.description: The book's own fields for each entry type, such as HP for characters or Rarity for items. Entries keep their values under "fields" by key.

key.description: The value's name in the entry files and in game data. Made from the first name; it stays when the field is renamed.

kind.description: yes-no values are true or false.

choices.description: The values a choice field can have.
